intent.note: Clause 1 'Declare every filter axis ONCE in a registry next to the state in page-state.js (load order unchanged)': page-state.js:428 `const FILTER_AXES = [` sits beside the state lets (page-state.js:334-376, all axis state declared there, so no TDZ from the closures); entries search/phase-status/area/model/test-gate/observed/dates/author/task-status each carry attrs, keys (task-status keys [] with a one-line `unkept` reason), scope (tasks vs phases vs drill vs usage), counts, on/reset/paint/encode/decode; the default is expressed by `reset` rather than a separate field, which the docstring states ('return it to its default'). _SCRIPT_PARTS order untouched. Clause 2 'clearAll (date-range.js), syncHash and refresh's narrows/anyFilter/fcount (filters.js), and the restore block (exports.js) iterate the registry': date-range.js clearAll is `FILTER_AXES.forEach((axis) => { axis.reset(); axis.paint(); })`; filters.js syncHash loops `axis.encode()` over `axis.keys`; refresh derives `live`, `narrows` (scope==='tasks'), `anyFilter` (scope!=='usage'), Clear offer (`!live.length`) and `nHidden` (`axis.counts`) from the registry; exports.js restore is `FILTER_AXES.forEach((axis) => { if (axis.decode(HASH)) axis.paint(); })`. The per-task match predicate still names modelFilter/tevFilter etc., which the clause does not cover. Clause 3 'per-phase task-status chips count toward fcount/anyFilter and are lifted by Clear': task-status has counts:true, scope 'drill' (in anyFilter), reset+paint repaint every tf host via the new host.__pid (chips.js:107). Additionally authors.js now calls refresh() after a pick so Clear is offered for the author scope - a second instance of the class, within the clause's intent. Clause 4 (construct pins, count against data-ps/m/tev/tevf/a/au/days/ts, prove red by removing an axis): test_render_report.py rx1-rx9 replace c3/d1/tv-r5/tv-r6; rx2 holds wireChips-derived attrs plus the named tuple against the registry; rx6 forbids the reset-derived state names inside each consumer. I ran `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_render_report.py` once: exit 0, 302 cases, matching the claim's 302/302. Clause 5 ('Clear lifts every axis', DOM-derived, one control at a time, Clear, nothing pressed / fcount / hash / audit-view-* / phase count / reload; unrendered chip reported as not exercised): check-report-interactive.mjs cl0-cl9 do exactly that, controls read off CL_CHIPS/CL_FIELDS, wired attrs no exercised control carries go into the note as 'not exercised, not passed'. Clause 6 (re-render artifacts): examples/, docs/index.html, docs/demo-large.html and docs/screenshots are in the diff. CLAIM vs DIFF: the outcome's description of each file ('clearAll = FILTER_AXES.forEach reset+paint', 'syncHash loops encode over keys', 'restore = forEach decode(HASH) then paint', 'authors.js handlers call refresh()', 'chips.js tags each tf host with its phase id') matches the diff line for line; the stamp grades `current` under stamp-verification.py compare (exit 0).
